description: ごみ・資源物処理の推移と内訳 [waste management] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎市. 過去5年間のごみ処理実績（区分ごとの排出量、資源化率、最終処分量など）の推移. Coverage: 宮崎市. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎市. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-02-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
